summary: A manager at {workplace} invites questions after telling the crew its work will go to a contractor.
realLife: Fibreboard told the machinists that it had decided to outsource maintenance and would answer questions, although it saw no point in negotiating a new agreement.
gates: The case record identifies the written decision, effective date and remaining bargaining opportunity.
inGame: needs: written decision, effective date and remaining bargaining opportunity.

turns.what: The union records when it first learned of the transfer.
The crew can submit a competing plan.
